categories.name: Traps
categories.description: Questions related to various traps in the movies.

questions.question: In the Venus Fly trap, informant Michael Marks must retrieve a key located somewhere within his body in order to remove the death mask around his neck. Where has the key been ensconced?
In the Pound of Flesh trap, Simone, a slender woman, faces off against Eddie, a much larger and heavier man, over who can "donate" the most flesh by weight. How does she manage to beat him?
questions.answer: By chopping off and donating her arm

questions.question: In the Classroom trap, repeat offender Troy manages to free himself from all but one of various chains hooked to his body before being torn apart by a nail bomb explosion. Which body part was the remaining chain attached to?

In the Pig Vat, Judge Halden is strapped to the bottom of a large vat as it fills with the shredded, liquefied juices of rotting pig carcasses. In order to save him, what must Jeff Denlon do in order to retrieve the key to Halden's restraint?
Per Jigsaw's final request, Jill Tuck places Mark Hoffman in an unwinnable Reverse Bear Trap. How does the Hoffmanator manage to escape?
questions.answer: He frees himself from his restraint by smashing his hand with the RBT before ramming it between the metal bars on the door's window and tearing it off his head

questions.question: To which country does Jigsaw travel to while under the impression that he will be undergoing a new experimental cancer treatment?
How does Jigsaw ultimately die?
questions.answer: Throat slit with a circular saw wielded by Jeff Denlon

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Jigsaw makes an appearance in every Saw entry, either alive or through flashbacks post-mortem, except for ___.
questions.endnote: He is only mentioned by name or shown in photographs

questions.question: What type of animal does Jigsaw use as a metaphor for insurance companies while observing the aquarium in William Easton's office?
Why do Jigsaw and his apprentices wear pig masks?
questions.answer: Jigsaw's son was supposed to be born during the Chinese Year of the Pig

questions.question: In total, how many confirmed deaths have occurred in the Bathroom throughout the series?
